body:
CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: feat(render): real procedural textures for terrain/walls -- draw_terrain/draw_map were pure flat-shaded vertex color, no texture at all. Added seamlessly-tileable ground (banded fbm noise) and wall (running-bond brick) procedural generators to proc_tex.c, bound under the existing per-vertex lighting/fog. Founder: 'lets start adding textures to shankpit... bring us from like 1982 graphics to 1999 graphics.' Live-verified via Xvfb screenshot. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
